title: IPTV Players Compared: TiviMate, OTT Navigator, Kodi, VLC
description: Independent guides to IPTV player apps: TiviMate, OTT Navigator, Kodi, VLC and others. Features, EPG support, device compatibility and honest comparisons.
intro: A player app is what turns a playlist and a guide into something that feels like television. We cover the major players on every platform, explain what each does well and compare them on the features that matter: EPG handling, catch-up, recording, multi-view and stability.

faq.question: Are IPTV player apps legal?
faq.answer: Yes. Players like VLC, Kodi or TiviMate are general-purpose media apps. Legality depends on the content you load into them, not on the app itself.
